text:
Ryan G: Quick sync — Finance wants a clear mapping from pricing plans -> enforced quota rules for API and console. Need per-org & per-key limits, burst behavior, and what we surface in the Console/billing dashboard. Can we decide by Friday? :calendar:
Priya Patel: We can reuse rate-limiterv2. It supports token-bucket per-key + per-org, but no per-plan overrides yet. We can layer plan config on top.
Jessica P: Product proposal: Free = 100k tokens/day, 60 rpm (requests per minute) with 15 req/s burst; Pro = 5M tokens/day, 600 rpm, 50 req/s burst; Enterprise = negotiated, default unlimited but enforced by SLOs and custom limits.
Alex I: Ops concern: 'unlimited' is dangerous. For Enterprise we need soft caps + opt-in hard caps per contract. Suggest default soft limit with automatic alerting and enforced hard limit only after sales config.
Priya Patel: Enforcement modes: 'soft' = allow + bill/telemetry + WARN header; 'strict' = 429 immediate. Also 'throttle' where we return 503 with Retry-After for short bursts.
Ryan G: Can we attach metadata to requests for telemetry: plan=free/pro/ent, commit_id, org_id? We need that for billing rollups.
Theo - Billing: yes, billing needs plan tag + rate_limit_bucket to map consumption to price. Also need events for when soft limits are exceeded.
Alex I: Implementation sketch:
```json
{
  "plans": {
    "free": {"daily_tokens":100000, "burst_rps":15, "enforcement":"soft"},
    "pro": {"daily_tokens":5000000, "burst_rps":50, "enforcement":"strict"},
    "enterprise": {"daily_tokens":null, "burst_rps":200, "enforcement":"soft_or_contract"}
  }
}
```
Priya Patel: Additional: per-key meter + per-org aggregate. Bursts should be allowed for short windows: token-bucket refill_rate etc. We should expose `X-RateLimit-*` headers and a console graph for 'burst events/day'.
Jessica P: UX: show current plan limit, next overage cost, and a 'request limit upgrade' CTA. For enterprise show 'Report peak' to sales.
InfraBot: deploy:rate-limiterv2 queued, ETA 2h
Ryan G: Action items: Priya to draft enforcement PR (config + headers), Alex to add alerting runbook, Theo to list billing events, Jessica to update Console mockups. Sync Friday 10am.
Priya Patel: I'll put the PR up today linking this thread. :thumbsup:
